verdict_detail: We found no public tracker that maps rules on AI prescribing across countries and US states, or codes them by how much independence the AI has; more than 20 sources could not be checked (see coverage_limits). The closest, the Health & AI Policy Index, groups prescribing with other reserved clinical functions; Manatt's quarterly tracker describes the Utah pilots in prose. Other trackers cover general AI or health-AI law without a prescribing field, and Utah's own register covers one state. OECD.AI and WHO have no prescribing content.
closest: Utah Office of AI Policy, Authorized AI Pilots register (primary, one state)
Manatt Health AI Policy Tracker (narrative, US only, no prescribing category)
NCSL AI-in-health-care legislation database (cited as tagging 11 autonomous clinical decision-making bills; URL not found)
Snell & Wilmer, 'When AI Writes the Prescription' (2026-10-07) and Holland & Knight, 'The AI Doctor Will See You Now' (2026-10-19): best multi-state snapshots, not maintained
NEJM / JAMA / JAMA Health Forum commentaries on the Utah pilot (Utah only)
coverage_limits: The session's web-search budget ran out early, so several sources were checked only by guessed URL or not at all: Epstein Becker Green, Foley, Hogan Lovells, Covington, Husch Blackwell, FSMB (403), verticomply, startbusinessbystate, SSRN, Health Affairs, Brookings, R Street, Mercatus, Niskanen, Paragon, PPI, Abundance Institute, Institute for Progress, STAT, KFF, Axios, GitHub, Avalere. Rerun those before calling the verdict final.

items.name: Manatt Health: Health AI Policy Tracker
items.what_it_lacks: Quarterly narrative newsletter (latest Q3 2026, October 27), not a database or map; the full bill list is for subscribers. Describes all four Utah pilots in prose; no prescribing category, no state-by-state coding of AI prescribing, and no H.R. 238. US only.
items.notes: Closest law-firm product. Notes Idaho and Iowa bills would create licensed AI providers with tiered licensing by autonomy (Cicero model), not expected to advance. Counts 46 bills in 27 states on AI in care settings in 2026, 7 enacted in 6 states.

items.name: Utah Office of AI Policy: Authorized AI Pilots
items.operator: Utah Department of Commerce, Office of Artificial Intelligence Policy
items.scope: register of sandbox agreements (prescribing-heavy in practice)
items.what_it_lacks: One state; primary-source register, not a comparison; no rung classification (each entry describes its phased review model).
items.notes: Four prescribing pilots: Doctronic, Legion Health, August AI, Nolla Health.

items.name: NCSL Artificial Intelligence 2025 Legislation
items.scope: general AI law (has a 'Health Use' tag)
items.what_it_lacks: 2025 bills only (updated July 10, 2025); health bills share a general 'Health Use' tag; no prescribing field; lists sandbox bills but not Utah's agreements; bills rather than the legal state of play.
items.notes: Dorsey cites a separate NCSL AI-in-health-care database (280+ bills in 44 states as of June 2026, 11 on autonomous clinical decision-making); its URL could not be found.

items.name: AI Laws by State: Healthcare AI Tracker
items.geography: US states plus some federal bills
items.what_it_lacks: 117 bills in 5 categories, mostly utilization review; no prescribing category (closest is 'Clinical Decision Making', 7 bills); Idaho H 945, Delaware HB 191, Oregon's title law and H.R. 238 not listed when checked; no sandboxes, rungs or international.

items.name: Orrick U.S. State AI Law Tracker
items.what_it_lacks: Enacted laws only; no prescribing, sandboxes or rungs.
items.notes: Includes Delaware HB 191 and Texas SB 1188, useful as restriction entries.

items.name: IAPP US State AI Governance Legislation Tracker
items.what_it_lacks: Explicitly excludes sector-specific (health) laws.

items.name: Live Compliance AI healthcare regulation map
items.what_it_lacks: 63 rules, none on AI prescribing; lists Utah's AI Policy Act but not its sandbox prescribing agreements; no rungs or international.

items.name: CCHP Policy Finder: Online Prescribing
items.what_it_lacks: Nothing on AI. Useful as a format model and for human remote-prescribing rules.

items.name: StateVitals monthly roundup (Dec 2025)
items.what_it_lacks: News roundup, not a tracker; Utah only.
items.notes: Mentions AI sandboxes in Arizona and Texas, Wyoming developing one.

items.name: Holland & Knight: The AI Doctor Will See You Now
items.what_it_lacks: One-time alert; no table; Utah only for prescribing.
items.notes: Most current description of all four Utah prescribing pilots, incl. Nolla first-time topical acne prescriptions.

items.name: Holland & Knight (via JD Supra): States Continue Efforts to Regulate AI in Healthcare, 2026 legislation review
items.what_it_lacks: Snapshot of enacted 2026 laws; no prescribing category; sandboxes mentioned in passing.
items.notes: Lists Delaware HB 191 (no AI licensure as physician/nurse/PA), Maine, Tennessee mental-health AI limits.
